summary.zh: 暗影箭与献祭各少半秒、射程提高 20%、法力消耗降低 10%，20 级再拿暗影灼烧。
summary.en: Half a second off Shadow Bolt and Immolate, 20% more range, 10% cheaper spells, and Shadowburn at 20.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，在最大射程外施放暗影箭与献祭
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, Shadow Bolt and Immolate from maximum range

pros.zh: 灾祸让暗影箭与献祭的施法时间缩短 0.5 秒，灵魂之火缩短 2 秒。
pros.en: Bane cuts 0.5 seconds from Shadow Bolt and Immolate and 2 seconds from Soul Fire.

pros.zh: 毁灭延伸让伤害法术射程提高 20%，通常意味着怪走到你面前之前能多打一发暗影箭。
pros.en: Destructive Reach adds 20% range to your damaging spells, which is usually one extra Shadow Bolt before anything reaches you.

pros.zh: 灾变让毁灭系法术的法力消耗降低 10%。
pros.en: Cataclysm reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by 10%.

pros.zh: 暗影灼烧是瞬发终结技，目标在命中后 8 秒内死亡时返还一个灵魂碎片。
pros.en: Shadowburn is an instant finisher that returns a Soul Shard when the target dies within 8 seconds of being hit.

pros.zh: 组队时射程不那么关键，通常会把毁灭延伸换成强化暗影箭。
pros.en: Improved Shadow Bolt is the usual swap for Destructive Reach in groups, where the extra range matters less.
